description: This file defines a UserService class that manages user registration, authentication, profile management, and password updates via a Supabase backend, integrating with FastAPI for HTTP exception handling.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service to manage users via Supabase Auth and 'profiles' table.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] register_user(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password, returning the result of the sign-up process.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] ensure_profile(self, auth_result: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Ensures a user profile exists in the 'profiles' table for the given authentication result; creates one if necessary.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] authenticate_user(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, ensures profile existence, and returns user info.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_user_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user profile from the database by email.

methods.name: None update_password(self, email: str, new_password: str)
methods.description: Updates the password for a user identified by email.

ctags.name: authenticate_user
ctags.pattern: /^    async def authenticate_user(self, email: str, password: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: ensure_profile
ctags.pattern: /^    async def ensure_profile(self, auth_result: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: get_user_by_email
ctags.pattern: /^    async def get_user_by_email(self, email: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^    async def register_user(self, email: str, password: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: update_password
ctags.pattern: /^    async def update_password(self, email: str, new_password: str) -> None:$/
